from jax.experimental import pallas as pl
from jax.experimental.pallas import tpu as pltpu

def attention_kernel(
    slopes_ref,
    q_ref,
    k_ref,
    v_ref,
    o_ref,
    m_ref,
    d_ref,
    o_acc_ref,
):
  h_idx = pl.program_id(1)
  q_idx = pl.program_id(2)
  
  slope = slopes_ref[h_idx].astype(jnp.float32)
  q_block = q_ref[0, 0, :, :].astype(jnp.float32)
  
  d_dim = q_block.shape[1]
  scale = 1.0 / jnp.sqrt(jnp.float32(d_dim))
  
  bm = q_block.shape[0]
  m_ref[...] = jnp.full((bm,), -1e30, dtype=jnp.float32)
  d_ref[...] = jnp.zeros((bm,), dtype=jnp.float32)
  o_acc_ref[...] = jnp.zeros((bm, d_dim), dtype=jnp.float32)
  
  s_seq = k_ref.shape[2]
  bk = 128
  n_steps = s_seq // bk
  
  q_start = q_idx * bm
  q_indices = q_start + jnp.arange(bm, dtype=jnp.int32)
  
  for k_idx in range(n_steps):
    k_start = k_idx * bk
    k_block = k_ref[0, 0, k_start:k_start+bk, :].astype(jnp.float32)
    v_block = v_ref[0, 0, k_start:k_start+bk, :].astype(jnp.float32)
    
    k_indices = k_start + jnp.arange(bk, dtype=jnp.int32)
    
    scores = (q_block @ k_block.T) * scale
    rel_pos = k_indices[None, :] - q_indices[:, None]
    alibi_bias = slope * rel_pos.astype(jnp.float32)
    scores = scores + alibi_bias
    
    causal_mask = k_indices[None, :] <= q_indices[:, None]
    scores = jnp.where(causal_mask, scores, -1e30)
    
    m_prev = m_ref[...]
    d_prev = d_ref[...]
    o_acc = o_acc_ref[...]
    
    m_block = jnp.max(scores, axis=-1)
    m_new = jnp.maximum(m_prev, m_block)
    
    alpha = jnp.exp(m_prev - m_new)
    p_block = jnp.where(causal_mask, jnp.exp(scores - m_new[:, None]), 0.0)
    
    d_new = alpha * d_prev + jnp.sum(p_block, axis=-1)
    o_acc_new = alpha[:, None] * o_acc + p_block @ v_block
    
    m_ref[...] = m_new
    d_ref[...] = d_new
    o_acc_ref[...] = o_acc_new

  d_final = d_ref[...]
  o_final = o_acc_ref[...] / d_final[:, None]
  
  o_ref[0, 0, :, :] = o_final.astype(o_ref.dtype)

  b, h, s, d = q.shape
  bm = 128
  grid = (b, h, s // bm)

      num_scalar_prefetch=1,
      grid=grid,
      in_specs=[
          pl.BlockSpec((1, 1, bm, d), lambda b, h, q_idx, *_: (b, h, q_idx, 0)),
          pl.BlockSpec((1, 1, s, d), lambda b, h, q_idx, *_: (b, h, 0, 0)),
          pl.BlockSpec((1, 1, s, d), lambda b, h, q_idx, *_: (b, h, 0, 0)),
      ],
      out_specs=pl.BlockSpec((1, 1, bm, d), lambda b, h, q_idx, *_: (b, h, q_idx, 0)),
      scratch_shapes=[
          pltpu.VMEM((bm,), jnp.float32),
          pltpu.VMEM((bm,), jnp.float32),
          pltpu.VMEM((bm, d), jnp.float32),
      ],

      out_shape=jax.ShapeDtypeStruct((b, h, s, d), q.dtype),
